$comment.sms: Story 13.1b (`2026-11-06-450` AD9, Q-2): sms.code is the one text a newly approved field worker gets, carrying their code. BigDev's words. One variable, no name, no link, no word about pay or employment. The registered DLT text is this string with {code} as the DLT variable marker (templates 25, 26); it is proved through the real t() by apps/jobs/tests/field-worker-code-sms-templates.test.ts, so a change here is a change to a registered template. The Hindi still needs its review, Row 49 (b).
sms.code: TWT: फील्ड वर्कर के रूप में आपको स्वीकृति मिल गई है। आपका कोड {code} है। जिन शिक्षकों को आप जोड़ें, उन्हें यह कोड दें।
$comment.notice_email: Story 13.1g (`2026-11-12-463` AD4; ADR-0045): notice_email.* is the plain-text email each District Admin or Pariwar Admin named by a Story 13.1d move-request notice gets once per notice. ONE template per notice kind; its ONLY variable is {link}, the Move requests page (`/p/<pariwar id>/field-workers/requests`). No name, no mobile, no code, no district, no refusal reason, no cause, no date or time, no count, and no role the console notice for that kind does not name. "Tell the worker." is on accepted and refused only (`-459` Q3 A; `-461` item 2). The English is BigDev's (Q-1 A). The Hindi was agent-authored and is NOT YET HUMAN-REVIEWED - go-live gate Row 51 (f). The sent subject is the Hindi then the English, joined by ' / '; the body is the Hindi body and footer, a blank line, then the English body and footer. Rendered through the real t() by apps/jobs/src/scheduler/field-worker-notice-email-templates.ts; adding a field is a disclosure question for the Panel.
